content.title: Texas vs Purdue Live Stream: How to Watch Men’s March Madness
content.text: Purdue battles Texas on Thursday night in the Sweet 16 of the Men’s NCAA Tournament The Purdue Boilermakers face off against the Texas Longhorns with a berth in the Elite Eight on the line. The Boilermakers have looked good in their first two games, beating Queens and Miami (FL). They did trail the Hurricanes at halftime, but used a strong second half to pick up the win. They pulled away late to get the 10-point win. Fletcher Loyer was great in the win over the Hurricanes, as he scored 24 points. Braden Smith led the way in the first-round win, scoring 26 points. Smith is the team’s top scorer this season at 14.3 points per game. Loyer and Trey Kaufman-Renn are right behind him at 14.1 points per game. Kaufman-Renn is leading the team in rebounding at 8.5 boards per game. The Longhorns will need to find a way to slow down the trio if they want any shot at picking up another upset in the tournament. The Longhorns had to play in the First Four and they slipped by NC State. They then upset BYU by eight points and Gonzaga by six to earn a berth in the Sweet 16. The Longhorns have been led by Dailyn Smith this season. He is scoring a team-best 17.4 points per game. He is also leading the team in rebounding at 7.5 boards per game.
